spanish: O su tío, o hijo de su tío, lo redimirá, o desde resto de su carne desde su familia lo redimirá, o alcanzare su mano y se redimirá.

findings.issue: H7607 (construct with the flesh noun) is kin/flesh; «resto» adds remainder and makes that remainder the one who redeems.
Hiphil perfect 3fs is rendered as future subjunctive, adding a hypothetical mood the perfect does not mark.

notes: Qal «lo redimirá», niphal «se redimirá», both min prepositions, and «mano» match the tokens.
